name: ZenRead – Reading Progress Bar & Estimated Time
author: Tusher Ikbal

sections.description:
ZenRead is a lightweight and secure plugin that adds a sleek reading progress bar and an estimated reading time indicator to your WordPress posts. It helps in reducing bounce rates and improving engagement by giving readers a clear visual of their progress.

By showing how long a post will take to read and providing a smooth scrolling experience, ZenRead enhances the overall readability of your site.

Key Features

  • Reading Progress Bar: A smooth, customizable bar at the top of the page that tracks reading progress.
  • Estimated Reading Time: Automatically calculates and displays the reading time based on word count.
  • Scroll to Top Button: A customizable button with Dashicons support to help users navigate back to the top.
  • Fully Customizable: Easily change colors, bar height, padding, and margins from the settings page.
  • Performance Focused: Built with vanilla JavaScript and clean PHP, ensuring zero impact on site speed.
  • Secure: Fully follows WordPress.org security standards with data sanitization and escaping.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zenread folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the settings via the ‘Reading Tool’ menu in your WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does it work on pages?

ZenRead is currently optimized for single posts to provide the most accurate reading metrics.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes, you can fully customize the progress bar color, reading time background, and text colors from the settings panel.
